scope: One marked warm full pretrained shape flow, 512 synthetic tokens, original LoRA, compiler level 0. Compare generated TTNN on the same profiling-enabled Metal revision before/after real RoPE; not direct PJRT wall-time attribution or scene quality.
finding: Kernel duration sum drops from 2172.7ms to 603.6ms, while matrix-product duration remains 133.8/134.0ms. Large untilize, tilize, slice and binary costs largely disappear. Reshape is now the largest category (192.3ms). This validates the layout-cost cause of the speedup, not trajectory quality.
compatibility_repair: The first generated execution failed: Python omitted a CPU-hoisted si32-to-ui32 output cast declared in native IR. An explicit opt-in repair verifies the exact adjacent-pair indices and restores uint32 before embedding. Both failure and repaired artifacts are retained; no generated file or learned arithmetic was modified.
quality: Repaired generated execution passes the local stock FP32 CPU forward smoke gate. Complete synthetic trajectories remain failures, as recorded separately; no production-default change.
